integrity: Proof and exact start-position characterization accompany two separately constructed finite verification programs. Finite checks corroborate but do not establish the unrestricted result. The earlier 1976 foundational article is cited with bibliographic confirmation; its first public day is not established, and full text was not inspected in this investigation.
limitations: Applies to non-cyclic binary indicator pairs at shifts that are powers of two in complete dyadic prefixes; not arbitrary shifts, signed correlations, independent reviews, or general stationary autocorrelation.
title: Exact dyadic pair correlations of the Baum–Sweet support
